data.narrative:
WB Group is a pre-IPO defense and security company founded by Piotr Wojciechowski, Adam Bartosiewicz, and Krzysztof Wysocki. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private companies in the Defense & Security sector, including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

The peer-median valuation method is not applicable in this instance. While 23 same-sector peers exist broadly within Defense & Security, the narrow peer set meeting stage-specific or valuation-tier criteria yielded fewer than three comparable datapoints. Applying an all-sector median would introduce material methodological distortion given the heterogeneity of business models, technology readiness, and revenue maturity within defense and security. The available public comparable set (2 companies) and private peer group (8 companies) are too dispersed across development stages and scales to support a robust triangulated valuation range at this time.

Valuation of WB Group cannot be reliably derived from the current data. A defensible analysis would require either: accumulation of closer stage-matched private transactions, establishment of revenue or EBITDA anchors specific to the target, or specification of revenue multiples or DCF assumptions grounded in peer performance. The primary uncertainty is the absence of sufficient narrow comparables and lack of disclosed financial metrics for the target company.
